# import Enrich2 score files and annotate
```{r}
mor_scores_file = "data/DMS/main_identifiers_scores.tsv"

mor_variantscore_colnames <- c("hgvs", 
                               "SE_dms_1", "epsilon_dms_1", "score_dms_1",
                               "SE_dms_2", "epsilon_dms_2", "score_dms_2",
                               "SE_dms_3", "epsilon_dms_3", "score_dms_3",
                               "SE_dms_4", "epsilon_dms_4", "score_dms_4",
                               "SE_dms_5", "epsilon_dms_5", "score_dms_5",
                               "SE_dms_6", "epsilon_dms_6", "score_dms_6",
                               "SE_dms_7", "epsilon_dms_7", "score_dms_7",
                               "SE_dms_8", "epsilon_dms_8", "score_dms_8",
                               "SE_dms_9", "epsilon_dms_9", "score_dms_9",
                               "SE_dms_abundance", "epsilon_dms_abundance", "score_dms_abundance",
                               "SE_dms_internalization", "epsilon_dms_internalization", "score_dms_internalization",
                               "SE_dms_surface", "epsilon_dms_surface", "score_dms_surface")

mor_variantscore_coltypes <- c("hgvs", 
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
                               "numeric", "numeric", "numeric")


mor_scores <- read_delim(mor_scores_file, 
                         col_names = mor_variantscore_colnames, 
                         skip=3)

mor_scores <- process_hgvs_df(mor_scores)

mor_scores$is.wt = mor_scores$mutation_type == "S"

# remove row for mutation_type "X" from mor_scores
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>% filter(mutation_type != "X")

# make new df from mor_scores with only the score_dms columns, pos, len, mutation_type, and variants
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>% dplyr::select(hgvs, pos, len, mutation_type, variants, is.wt, starts_with("score_dms_"))
```

#import external data
```{r}
# import fortifications:

# import alpha missens .tsv file
mor_alpha_missense = read_tsv("data/alphamissense_OPRM_HUMAN.tsv")

# import csv of GPCRdb numbers
mor_gpcrdb = read.csv("data/GPCRdb_OPRM1_table.csv")

# import csv of conservation scores for non-olfactory class A
mor_conservation = read.csv("data/conservation_classA_nonolfactory_GPCRdb.csv")

# import gnomAD data csv
mor_gnomad = read.csv("data/gnomAD_OPRM1.csv")

# import atom distance to DAMGO (closest atom of ligand to atom of resi)
mor_damgo_distances = read.csv("data/damgo_ATOM_distances.csv")

# import G alpha distances (CA to CA)
mor_galpha_distances = read.csv("data/ga_CA_distances.csv")

# import amino acid volumes
amino_acid_vol = read.csv("data/amino_acid_volumes.csv")

#human mouse positions 
human_mouse_positions = read.csv("data/oprm_human_mouse_pos.csv")

# import raw counts data .csv file
raw_counts <- read.csv("data/DMS/main_identifiers_counts_cleaned.csv")

# make new df from raw_counts with only the columns hgvs, and any that start with "mean_"
mean_counts <- raw_counts %>% dplyr::select(hgvs, starts_with("mean_"))

```

#merge external data \# TODO: recalculate the Galpha distances to the MOR stucture and join to mor_scores, make the gnomad interpretable and join to mor_scores
```{r}
# join auxiliary data to the mor_scores datafame

# join the mor_gpcrdb to mor_scores by the pos column, keep all values in mor_scores
mor_scores = left_join(mor_scores, mor_gpcrdb, by = c("pos" = "pos"))

# join the mor_conservation to mor_scores by the GPCRdb column, keep all values in mor_scores
mor_scores = left_join(mor_scores, mor_conservation, by = c("GPCRdb" = "GPCRdb"))

# join the mor_alpha_missense to mor_scores by the hgvs column, keep all values in mor_scores
mor_scores = left_join(mor_scores, mor_alpha_missense, by = c("hgvs" = "hgvs"))

# join the mor_damgo_distances to mor_scores by the pos column, keep all values in mor_scores
mor_scores = left_join(mor_scores, mor_damgo_distances, by = c("pos" = "pos"))

# join the human mouse positions to mor_scores by the pos column, keep all values in mor_scores
mor_scores = left_join(mor_scores, human_mouse_positions, by = c("pos" = "pos"))

# join the amino acid volumes to mor_scores by the variants column, keep all values in mor_scores
mor_scores = left_join(mor_scores, amino_acid_vol, by = c("variants" = "variants"))
```

#data annotations
```{r}
# add a new column to mor_scores called motif and fill every row with NA
# then fill rows corresponding to the following motifs and residue numbers
# create a new column called motifs in mor_scores and fill with NA
# DRY: 166-168
# NPxxY: 334-338
# PIF: 246, 157, 294
# CWxP: 294-297
# Na pocket: 116 
# disulfide: 142,219
# waters: 148, 223, 297
# TSS:356,357,358
# phospho: 365, 366, 372, 385, 396
# glyco: N40


mor_scores$motif_activation = NA
# now fill motif column with motif name for pos above
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(166, 167, 168), "motif_activation"] = "DRY"
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(334, 335, 338), "motif_activation"] = "NPxxY"
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(246, 157, 291), "motif_activation"] = "PIF"
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(294, 295, 297), "motif_activation"] = "CWxP"
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(116), "motif_activation"] = "D2.50 (Na+)"
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(142, 219), "motif_activation"] = "disulfide"
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(149), "motif_activation"] = "D3.32"
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(170, 175, 179, 181, 265, 266, 272, 273, 279, 343), "motif_activation"] = "Ga-contact" #within 3.5A of Galpha




mor_scores$motif_internalization = NA
mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(356, 357, 358, 377, 378, 381, 365, 366, 372, 385, 396), "motif_activation"] = "phospho-site"

#mor_scores[mor_scores$pos %in% c(40), "motif"] = "glyco"



# add columns for amino acid properties size, charge, etc
# https://www.imgt.org/IMGTeducation/Aide-memoire/_UK/aminoacids/IMGTclasses.html

# polarity
nonpolar<- c('F','W','I','L','M', 'V','C','A','G','P')
polar<- c('N','Q','S','H','Y','T','R','K','D','E')

#charge
charged<- c('K','R','H','D','E')
uncharged<- c('Y','S','T','N','Q')

#aromaticity
aromatic<- c('F','W','Y','H')
nonaromatic<- c('R','K','D','E','S','T','N','C','P','A','G','I','L','M','V')

# h-bonding
donor<- c('R','K','W')
acceptor<- c('D','E')
both<- c('N','Q','S','T','Y','H')
none<- c('A','C','G','I','L','M','F','P','V')

#hydropathy
hydrophobic<- c('F','W','I','L','M', 'V','C','A')
hydrophilic<- c('N','Q','D','E','K','R')
neutral<- c('Y','H', 'P', 'G', 'S','T')

#size
very_large<- c('F','W','Y')
large<- c('R','K','I','L','M')
medium<- c('V','H','Q','E')
small<- c('D','N','C','P','T')
very_small<- c('A','G','S')

#chemistry 
aliphatic<- c('V','A','L','I')
sulfur<- c('C','M')
hydroxyl<- c('S','T','Y')
basic<- c('K','R','H')
acidic<- c('D','E')
amide<- c('N','Q')


mor_scores <- mor_scores %>%
  mutate(aromaticity = ifelse(variants %in% aromatic, 'aromatic', 'nonaromatic'))
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>%
  mutate(polarity = ifelse(variants %in% polar, 'polar', 'nonpolar'))
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>%
  mutate(charge = ifelse(variants %in% charged, 'charged', 'uncharged'))
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>%
  mutate(h_bonding = case_when(
    variants %in% donor ~ 'donor',
    variants %in% acceptor ~ 'acceptor',
    variants %in% both ~ 'both',
    variants %in% none ~ 'none',
    TRUE ~ 'unknown'  # add this line to handle unexpected values
  ))
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>%
  mutate(hydropathy = case_when(
    variants %in% hydrophobic ~ 'hydrophobic',
    variants %in% hydrophilic ~ 'hydrophilic',
    variants %in% neutral ~ 'neutral',
    TRUE ~ 'unknown'  # add this line to handle unexpected values
  ))
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>%
  mutate(size = case_when(
    variants %in% very_large ~ 'very_large',
    variants %in% large ~ 'large',
    variants %in% medium ~ 'medium',
    variants %in% small ~ 'small',
    variants %in% very_small ~ 'very_small',
    TRUE ~ 'unknown'  # add this line to handle unexpected values
  ))
mor_scores <- mor_scores %>%
  mutate(chemistry = case_when(
    variants %in% aliphatic ~ 'aliphatic',
    variants %in% sulfur ~ 'sulfur',
    variants %in% hydroxyl ~ 'hydroxyl',
    variants %in% basic ~ 'basic',
    variants %in% acidic ~ 'acidic',
    variants %in% amide ~ 'amide',
    TRUE ~ 'unknown'  # add this line to handle unexpected values
  ))
```

# import raw counts data and parse out meean counts for each replicate
```{r}
# from the mean_counts df, calculate a mean across each replicate that average "mean_dms#_r#" values and returns a column called "mean_dms#"

# convert all mean_dms#_r# columns to numeric
mean_counts <- mean_counts %>%
  mutate_at(vars(starts_with("mean_dms")), as.numeric)


mean_counts <- mean_counts %>%
  mutate(mean_dms1 = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("mean_dms1_r"))))
mean_counts <- mean_counts %>%
  mutate(mean_dms2 = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("mean_dms2_r"))))
mean_counts <- mean_counts %>%
  mutate(mean_dms3 = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("mean_dms3_r"))))
mean_counts <- mean_counts %>%
  mutate(mean_dms4 = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("mean_dms4_r"))))
mean_counts <- mean_counts %>%
  mutate(mean_dms5 = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("mean_dms5_r"))))
mean_counts <- mean_counts %>%
  mutate(mean_dms6 = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("mean_dms6_r"))))

# create a mean bins df taking hgvs and mean_dms# columns from mean counts
mean_bins <- mean_counts %>% dplyr::select(hgvs, mean_dms1, mean_dms2, mean_dms3, mean_dms4, mean_dms5, mean_dms6)

# join mean_bins to mor_scores by hgvs, keep all values
mor_scores <- left_join(mor_scores, mean_bins, by = c("hgvs" = "hgvs"))

mor_scores_missense <- mor_scores %>% filter(mutation_type %in% c("M", "S"))

```

#density plots by mutation type
```{r}
# create a theme for the plots that is based on theme_classic(), but set all font sizes to 6 and all text to black
my_theme <- theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black")
    )


#plot densities of all scores
# Function to create density plots
create_density_plot <- function(data, score_column, label) {
  ggplot(data) +
    geom_density(aes(x = !!sym(score_column), color = mutation_type)) +
    xlab(label) +
    ylab("Density") +
    #geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    my_theme +
    labs(color = "Mutation type") +
    xlim(-3, 3) +
    ylim(0, 2)
}

# List to store density plots
density_plots <- list()

# Score columns and labels
score_columns <- c("score_dms_internalization", "score_dms_surface", "score_dms_abundance", 
                   "score_dms_1", "score_dms_2", "score_dms_3", "score_dms_4", "score_dms_5", "score_dms_6")

labels <- c("internalization", "surface", "abundance", "dms1", "dms2", "dms3", "dms4", "dms5", "dms6")

# Create density plots and store them in the list
for (i in seq_along(score_columns)) {
  density_plots[[i]] <- create_density_plot(mor_scores, score_columns[i], labels[i])
}

# Arrange plots using patchwork
combined_plots <- wrap_plots(density_plots, ncol = 3)

# Save the combined plot
ggsave("output/plots/master_density_plots.pdf", combined_plots, width = 10, height = 10)

```

# density plots by motif enrich (all scores) and mean bin (Gi-signaling scores)
```{r}
# Function to create density plots
create_density_plot <- function(data, score_column, label) {
    data <- data %>% filter(mutation_type %in% c("M"))  
  ggplot(data) +
    geom_density(aes(x = !!sym(score_column), color = motif_activation)) +
    xlab(label) +
    ylab("Density") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    my_theme +
    labs(color = "motif") +
    xlim(-3.5, 3.5) +
    ylim(0, 2.5)
}

# List to store density plots
density_plots <- list()

# Score columns and labels
score_columns <- c("score_dms_internalization", "score_dms_surface", "score_dms_abundance",

create_density_plot <- function(data, score_column, label) {
  # Check if mutation_type and score_column are present in data
  # if (!all(c("mutation_type", score_column) %in% names(data))) {
  #   stop("Mutation_type or specified score_column not found in data.")
  # }
  
  # Filter data for mutation_type "S"
  data_s <- data %>% filter(mutation_type == "S")
  
  # # Check if there is any data for mutation_type "S"
  # if (nrow(data_s) == 0) {
  #   stop("No data available for mutation_type 'S'.")
  # }
  
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation for mutation_type "S"
  mean_s <- mean(data_s[[score_column]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_s <- sd(data_s[[score_column]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot(data %>% filter(mutation_type == "M")) +
    geom_density_ridges(aes(x = !!sym(score_column), y = motif_activation, fill = motif_activation),
                        alpha = 0.7, scale = 0.9) +
    xlab(label) +
    ylab("Density") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    # geom_vline(xintercept = mean_s, linetype = "dotted") +
    # geom_vline(xintercept = mean_s - sd_s, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
    # geom_vline(xintercept = mean_s + sd_s, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +

    my_theme +
    xlim(-3.5, 3.5)
}
```

```{r}
# make scatter plots of all scores against all scores
plot_mor_scores <- function(data, x_var, y_var, color_var) {
  ggplot(data %>% filter(mutation_type == "M")) +
    geom_point(aes(x = {{x_var}},
                   y = {{y_var}},
                   color = !!sym(color_var))) +
    my_theme +
    labs(color = color_var) +
    xlim(-3, 3) +
    ylim(-3, 3)
}

# Define the list of variables
variables <- c("score_dms_surface", "score_dms_internalization", "score_dms_abundance", 
               "score_dms_1", "score_dms_2", "score_dms_3", 
               "score_dms_4", "score_dms_5", "score_dms_6")

# Define the list of color variables
color_variables <- c("motif_activation", "conservation", "mutation_type", "alphamissense_classification", "SSE", "damgo_distance", "aa_volume", "chemistry", "aromaticity", "h_bonding", "charge", "polarity", "hydropathy", "size")

# Iterate over all combinations of x, y, and color variables
for (color_var in color_variables) {
  # Initialize an empty list to store scatter plots
  scatter_plots <- list()

  for (x_var in variables) {
    for (y_var in variables) {
      # Create the scatter plot and store it in the list
      scatter_plot <- plot_mor_scores(data = mor_scores, 
                                      x_var = !!sym(x_var), 
                                      y_var = !!sym(y_var),
                                      color_var = sym(color_var))
      scatter_plots <- c(scatter_plots, list(scatter_plot))
    }
  }

  # Combine the scatter plots using patchwork
  grid_plot <- wrap_plots(scatter_plots, ncol = 9)

  # Display the grid plot
  grid_plot

  # Save the grid plot as a PDF with a dynamic filename
  ggsave(paste0("output/plots/master_scatter_missense_", color_var, ".pdf"), grid_plot, width = 40, height = 40)
}
```

#apply diagonal magic
```{r}
# full scatter, euclidian distance, waterfall plot summing distances/position for positive and negative distances
# Define a function for creating a scatter plot with distances
mor_scores_missense <- mor_scores %>% filter(mutation_type %in% c("M", "S"))

full_scatter_distance_summed_signed <- function(data, x_var, y_var, y_var_for_line, output_file) {
  # Define labels for x and y variables based on their names
  x_var_label <- x_var
  y_var_label <- y_var

  
  # Set the theme options for all text elements
  theme_options <- theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",fill = NA, size = 1),
    text = element_text(color = "black", family = "sans", size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, family = "sans", color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans", color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans", color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans", color = "black"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans", color = "black"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  )

  # Fit a linear regression model to the data using syn mutants of y_var_for_line and surf_score
  lm_model <- lm(data %>% filter(is.wt == TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(y_var_for_line, score_dms_surface))
  lm_model_all <- lm(data %>% dplyr::select(y_var_for_line, score_dms_surface))
  
  # Obtain the coefficients (a, b, c) from the lm_model
  a <- coef(lm_model)[2]
  b <- -1  # Assuming b as -1 for perpendicular distance
  c <- coef(lm_model)[1]
 
  # Calculate the R-squared value from the linear regression model
  r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared
  r_squared_all <- summary(lm_model_all)$r.squared
  
  # Format the R-squared value as a string
  r_squared_label <- paste("R-squared(syn/all) = ", round(r_squared, 2), "/", round(r_squared_all, 2))

  # Calculate the signed distances from each point (x_var, y_var) to the line
  data$distance <- -(a * data[[x_var]] + b * data[[y_var]] + c) / sqrt(a^2 + b^2) 

  # Create a dataFrame for distances
  distance_df <- data.frame(hgvs = data$hgvs, distance = data$distance, pos = data$pos, is.wt = data$is.wt, variants = data$variants, motif = data$motif)
  # Remove rows with missing distances in the distance_df
  distance_df <- distance_df %>% filter(!is.na(distance))
  
  # Identify the top 5% highest distances
  top_5_percent_cutoff <- quantile(distance_df$distance, probs = 0.975)
  top_5_percent_data <- distance_df %>% filter(distance >= top_5_percent_cutoff)
  bottom_5_percent_cutoff <- quantile(distance_df$distance, probs = 0.025)
  bottom_5_percent_data <- distance_df %>% filter(distance <= bottom_5_percent_cutoff)

  # Add a "percentile" column to the input dataframe
  data$percentile <- ifelse(data$hgvs %in% top_5_percent_data$hgvs, "top", ifelse(data$hgvs %in% bottom_5_percent_data$hgvs, "bottom", "neutral"))

  # Separate distances into two data frames: below and above the best fit line
  below_df <- distance_df[distance_df$distance < 0, ]
  above_df <- distance_df[distance_df$distance >= 0, ]

  # Calculate the absolute sum of distances by position and divide by the count
  above_sum_df <- above_df %>%
    group_by(pos) %>%
    summarize(abs_sum_distance = sum((distance)) / n())
  
  below_sum_df <- below_df %>%
    group_by(pos) %>%
    summarize(abs_sum_distance = sum((distance)) / n())

  # Create a scatter plot with grey color for all points and blue for "top" points
  scatter_plot <- ggscatter(data, x = x_var, y = y_var, size = 0.5, color = "#999999") +
    labs(x = x_var_label, y = y_var_label) +
    theme_options + 
    #coord_equal(1) +
    ggtitle(paste0(x_var_label, " vs ", y_var_label, " (mis/syn dataset)\n", r_squared_label )) +
    geom_smooth(data = data %>% filter(is.wt == TRUE), aes(x = score_dms_surface, y = !!sym(y_var_for_line)), method = "lm", color = "black", size = 0.5, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2, fullrange = TRUE) +
    geom_point(data = data %>% filter(is.wt == TRUE), aes(x = score_dms_surface, y = !!sym(y_var_for_line)), size = 0.75, color = "black") +
    geom_point(data = data %>% filter(percentile == "top"),aes(x = score_dms_surface, y = !!sym(y_var_for_line)), size = 0.5,color = "blue") +
    geom_point(data = data %>% filter(percentile == "bottom"),aes(x = score_dms_surface, y = !!sym(y_var_for_line)), size = 0.5, color = "red")


above_sum_df$pos <- as.numeric(above_sum_df$pos)  # Convert 'pos' to numeric
below_sum_df$pos <- as.numeric(below_sum_df$pos)  # Convert 'pos' to numeric


above_sum_df$motif = NA

# now fill motif column with motif name for pos above
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(166, 167, 168), "motif"] = "DRY"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(334, 335, 336, 337, 338), "motif"] = "NPxxY"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(246, 157, 294), "motif"] = "PIF"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(294, 295, 296, 297), "motif"] = "CWxP"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(116), "motif"] = "Na+ pocket"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(142, 219), "motif"] = "disulfide"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(149, 223, 297), "motif"] = "waters"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(356, 357, 358), "motif"] = "TSS"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(377, 378, 379, 380, 381), "motif"] = "STANT"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(365, 366, 372, 385, 396), "motif"] = "phospho"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(40), "motif"] = "glyco"
above_sum_df[above_sum_df$pos %in% c(103, 170, 171, 174, 175, 178, 179, 181, 260, 261, 265, 266, 266, 270, 272, 273, 279, 280, 342, 343, 344), "motif"] = "Ga-contact"

below_sum_df$motif = NA

# now fill motif column with motif name for pos below
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(166, 167, 168), "motif"] = "DRY"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(334, 335, 336, 337, 338), "motif"] = "NPxxY"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(246, 157, 294), "motif"] = "PIF"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(294, 295, 296, 297), "motif"] = "CWxP"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(116), "motif"] = "Na+ pocket"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(142, 219), "motif"] = "disulfide"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(149, 223, 297), "motif"] = "waters"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(356, 357, 358), "motif"] = "TSS"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(377, 378, 379, 380, 381), "motif"] = "STANT"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(365, 366, 372, 385, 396), "motif"] = "phospho"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(40), "motif"] = "glyco"
below_sum_df[below_sum_df$pos %in% c(103, 170, 171, 174, 175, 178, 179, 181, 260, 261, 265, 266, 266, 270, 272, 273, 279, 280, 342, 343, 344), "motif"] = "Ga-contact"

distance_plot_above <- ggplot(data = above_sum_df %>%
         arrange(abs_sum_distance), aes(x = log(as.numeric(reorder(pos, desc(abs_sum_distance)))), y = abs_sum_distance)) +
    labs(x = "Rank", y = "Sum distances") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = motif), size = 3, shape = 21) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = c(1, 10, 100), 
                       breaks = log(c(1, 10, 100)), 
                       expand = c(.025, .025)) +
    ggtitle(y_var_label) +
    theme_options +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(above_sum_df$abs_sum_distance)), expand = c(0.07,0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("none" = rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha=0), "ecl" = rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha=0)))

# Create a plot for ranked positions and their absolute sum of distances
distance_plot_below <- ggplot(data = below_sum_df %>%
         arrange(abs_sum_distance), aes(x = log(as.numeric(reorder(pos, abs_sum_distance))), y = abs_sum_distance)) +
 
  labs(x = "Rank, log-scale", y = "Sum distances") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = motif), size = 3, shape = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = c(1, 10, 100), 
                       breaks = log(c(1, 10, 100)), 
                       expand = c(.025, .025)) +
  ggtitle(y_var_label) +
  theme_options +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(below_sum_df$abs_sum_distance), expand = c(0, 0))) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("none" = rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha=0), "ecl" = rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha=0))) 

# For distance_plot_above
distance_plot_above <- distance_plot_above +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = above_sum_df[order(-above_sum_df$abs_sum_distance), ][1:15, ],
    aes(label = pos),
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 1,
    size = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  )


# For distance_plot_below
distance_plot_below <- distance_plot_below +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = head(below_sum_df[order(below_sum_df$abs_sum_distance), ], 15),
    aes(x = log(as.numeric(reorder(pos, abs_sum_distance))), y = abs_sum_distance, label = pos),
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 1,
    size = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  )


  # Arrange distance plot vertically and collect guides
  plot_arranged <- scatter_plot / distance_plot_above / distance_plot_below + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
    

  ggsave(output_file, plot_arranged, height = 200, width = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 450)
  # Return the distance df
  return(list(above_sum_df, below_sum_df, distance_df))
}
```

```{r}
# make a plot of  each mean_dms# score for each row where mutation_type is "S" and draw horizontal lines at the overall mean value of mean_dms# and +/- one SD from the mean

plot_mean_dms <- function(column_number) {
  # Generate the column name based on the input number
  column_name <- paste0("mean_dms", column_number)
  
  # Filter data for mutation_type == "S"
  filtered_data <- mor_scores %>% filter(mutation_type == "S")
  
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation for mutation_type "S"
  mean_value <- mean(filtered_data[[column_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_value <- sd(filtered_data[[column_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sem_value <- sd_value / sqrt(length(filtered_data[[column_name]]))
  print(paste("Mean", column_name, "mutation_type is 'S':", mean_value))
  print(paste("Standard deviation of", column_name, "mutation_type is 'S':", sd_value))
  
  # Create the ggplot
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = pos, y = !!rlang::sym(column_name))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = paste("Mean", column_name, "mutation_type is 'S'"),
         x = "Position",
         y = paste("Mean", column_name, "score")) +
    theme_classic() +
    # Add horizontal line for mean
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_value, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue") +
    # Add horizontal lines for mean +/- SD
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_value + 2*sd_value, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_value - 2*sd_value, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") + 
    ylim(1, 4) +
    # Set text size and color
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"))
}

# Example usage: plot_mean_dms(3)
(plot_mean_dms(1) + plot_mean_dms(2) + plot_mean_dms(3)) / (plot_mean_dms(4) + plot_mean_dms(5) + plot_mean_dms(6))

ggsave("output/plots/mean_bin_syn_score_per_pos.png", width = 10, height = 10, units = "cm")

a + plot_mean_dms(6)
```




```{r}
# now make a line plot that has mean_dms1, mean_dms2, mean_dms3, mean_dms4, mean_dms5, and mean_dms6 on the x-axis and plots the mean value of each mutation_type = "S" for each mean_dms# score on the y-axis
# first, we need to calculate the mean value of each mean_dms# score for each mutation_type = "S"

mean_dms_values_syn <- mor_scores %>% 
  filter(mutation_type == "S") %>% 
  summarise(mean_dms1 = mean(mean_dms1, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dms2 = mean(mean_dms2, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dms3 = mean(mean_dms3, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dms4 = mean(mean_dms4, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dms5 = mean(mean_dms5, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dms6 = mean(mean_dms6, na.rm = TRUE))

# Use pivot_longer to convert data from wide to long format
mean_dms_values_long_syn <- mean_dms_values_syn %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean_dms"), names_to = "key", values_to = "mean_value")

# Plot the data
ggplot(mean_dms_values_long_syn, aes(x = key, y = mean_value, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Mean value of each mean_dms# score for each mutation_type = 'S'",
       x = "Mean DMS# score",
       y = "Mean value") +
  theme_minimal()
###
# Calculate standard deviation for each mean_dms column
sd_values_syn <- mor_scores %>%
  filter(mutation_type == "S") %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("mean_dms"), sd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "key", values_to = "sd_value")

# Merge mean and sd data
merged_data <- merge(mean_dms_values_long_syn, sd_values_syn, by = "key")

# Plot the data with error bars
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = key, y = mean_value, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - sd_value, ymax = mean_value + sd_value), width = 0.2, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Mean bin value of each dms# score for syn +/-SD",
       y = "Mean bin") +
  theme_classic()
```
